board: FL-1 Calibration / Self-Test Board Rev A
description: Machine-readable manifest of every test point, probe-lane assignment, and expected measurement range for the FL-1 startup self-test sequence.

test_points.label: GND
test_points.description: Star ground reference for all measurements

test_points.label: SHORT_A
test_points.description: Short-circuit reference high side

test_points.label: SHORT_B
test_points.description: Short-circuit reference low side (same net as TP02)

tests.name: short_reference
tests.note: Kelvin pair to measure trace + contact resistance; expect < 500 mΩ

test_points.label: R10_A
test_points.description: 10 Ω 0.01% precision resistor high side

test_points.label: R10_B
test_points.description: 10 Ω 0.01% precision resistor low side (to GND)

tests.name: resistance_10ohm
tests.note: 0.01% ref: nominal 10.000 Ω ± 0.001 Ω; allow ± 0.5% for probe/contact resistance measurement uncertainty

test_points.label: R1K_A
test_points.description: 1 kΩ 0.01% precision resistor high side

test_points.label: R1K_B
test_points.description: 1 kΩ 0.01% precision resistor low side (to GND)

tests.name: resistance_1kohm
tests.note: 0.01% ref: nominal 1000.0 Ω ± 0.1 Ω; allow ± 0.1% for probe/contact

test_points.label: R100K_A
test_points.description: 100 kΩ 0.01% precision resistor high side

test_points.label: R100K_B
test_points.description: 100 kΩ 0.01% precision resistor low side (to GND)

tests.name: resistance_100kohm
tests.note: 0.01% ref: nominal 100.000 kΩ ± 10 Ω; allow ± 0.1% total

test_points.label: DI_A
test_points.description: Silicon diode (1N4148WS) anode

test_points.label: DI_K
test_points.description: Silicon diode (1N4148WS) cathode (to GND)

tests.name: silicon_diode_vf
tests.note: 1N4148WS Vf at DMM test current (0.1–1 mA typ): 0.60–0.70 V

tests.name: silicon_diode_reverse
tests.note: Reversed: DMM should show OL (>1 V range) = diode blocking

test_points.label: DS_A
test_points.description: Schottky diode (BAT54,215) anode

test_points.label: DS_K
test_points.description: Schottky diode (BAT54,215) cathode (to GND)

tests.name: schottky_diode_vf
tests.note: BAT54 Vf at 1 mA: 0.25–0.40 V typical

test_points.label: LED_A
test_points.description: LED path anode entry (before 330 Ω series resistor)

test_points.label: LED_K
test_points.description: LED cathode (after LED, to GND)

tests.name: led_path_resistance
tests.note: 330 Ω ± 5% series R dominates; LED forward-drop biases reading slightly high

tests.name: led_functional
tests.note: Apply 3.3 V at TP14; LED should illuminate, Vf across TP14-TP15 minus 330Ω drop

test_points.label: RC_IN
test_points.description: RC network input (one terminal of 10 kΩ series resistor)

test_points.label: RC_MID
test_points.description: RC junction between 10 kΩ R and 100 nF C (C to GND)

tests.name: rc_capacitance
tests.note: 100 nF ± 10%; DMM6500 capacitance mode measures C_RC directly to GND

tests.name: rc_time_constant
tests.note: τ = 10 kΩ × 100 nF = 1.00 ms ± 11%; measure via PicoScope step response

test_points.label: EE_VCC
test_points.description: EEPROM VCC supply input (FL-1 must drive 3.3 V here)

test_points.label: EE_GND
test_points.description: EEPROM GND (shared with board star ground)

test_points.label: EE_SDA
test_points.description: EEPROM I2C SDA (pulled up to EE_VCC on board)

test_points.label: EE_SCL
test_points.description: EEPROM I2C SCL (pulled up to EE_VCC on board)

tests.name: eeprom_read
tests.note: FL-1 drives 3.3 V on TP18, GND on TP19; FT4232H I2C on TP20/21

tests.name: eeprom_cal_constants
tests.note: Validates that cal constants page has been programmed

test_points.label: OPEN_A
test_points.description: Open-circuit reference pad A (no internal connection)

test_points.label: OPEN_B
test_points.description: Open-circuit reference pad B (no internal connection)

tests.name: open_reference
tests.note: Expect OL (>10 MΩ); verifies DMM can detect open circuit

pass_criteria: All gate_tests must pass. Non-gate tests log but do not block the FL-1 from proceeding to DUT testing.
